productDevelopers.title: Product developers
productDevelopers.description: Developers who answer customer questions about their products, on Telegram or by e-mail.

form.emailHint: Their work e-mail. When they connect the bot, they confirm it, so it must be exact.
form.telegramUsernameHint: They search the NIB Digital Solutions bot in Telegram, tap Start and confirm their work e-mail. Questions about their products then arrive there.

validation.telegramUsername: Use the Telegram username: 5–32 letters, digits or _, starting with a letter

telegram.title: Connect Telegram for {name}
telegram.description: Questions about this developer's products will arrive in Telegram, where they can reply directly.
telegram.step1: Ask the developer to open the NIB Digital Solutions bot in Telegram.
telegram.step2: They send this message to the bot (the code is valid for 30 minutes and works once):
telegram.step3: The bot confirms, and this page shows them as linked.
telegram.noBotName: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME to show a direct link to the bot.
